name: CommandBarPopup
description: Represents a popup control on a command bar.
remarks: Every pop-up control contains a CommandBar object. To return the command bar from a pop-up control, apply the CommandBar property to the CommandBarPopup object. Use Controls(_index_), where _index_ is the number of the control, to return a CommandBarPopup object. Note that the Type property of the control must be msoControlPopup, msoControlGraphicPopup, msoControlButtonPopup, msoControlSplitButtonPopup, or msoControlSplitButtonMRUPopup.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CommandBarPopup object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CommandBarPopup object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: BeginGroup
properties.description: Gets True if the specified command bar control appears at the beginning of a group of controls on the command bar. Read/write.

properties.name: BuiltIn
properties.description: Is True if the specified CommandBarPopup control is a built-in command bar of the container application. Returns False if it's a custom command bar. Read-only.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Gets or sets the caption text for a command bar control. Read/write.

properties.name: DescriptionText
properties.description: Gets or sets the description for a CommandBarPopup control. Read/write.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: Is True if the CommandBarPopup is enabled. Read/write.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Gets or sets the height of a CommandBarPopup control. Read/write.

properties.name: HelpContextId
properties.description: Gets or sets the Help context Id number for the Help topic attached to the CommandBarPopup control. Read/write.

properties.name: HelpFile
properties.description: Gets or sets the file name for the Help topic attached to the CommandBarPopup control. Read/write.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Gets the ID for a built-in CommandBarPopup control. Read-only.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Gets a Long representing the index number for a CommandBarPopup object in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Gets the horizontal position of the specified CommandBarPopup control (in pixels) relative to the left edge of the screen. Returns the distance from the left side of the docking area. Read-only.

properties.name: OLEUsage
properties.description: Gets or sets the OLE client and OLE server roles in which a CommandBarPopup control is used when two Microsoft Office applications are merged. Read/write.

properties.name: OnAction
properties.description: Gets or sets the name of a Visual Basic procedure that will run when the user clicks or changes the value of a CommandBarPopup control. Read/write.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CommandBarPopup object. Read-only.

properties.name: Parameter
properties.description: Gets or sets a string that an application can use to execute a command from a CommandBarPopup control. Read/write.

properties.name: Priority
properties.description: Gets or sets the priority of a CommandBarPopup control. Read/write.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: Gets or sets information about the CommandBarPopup control, such as data that can be used as an argument in procedures, or information that identifies the control. Read/write.

properties.name: TooltipText
properties.description: Gets or sets the text displayed in the ScreenTip of a CommandBarPopup. Read/write.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Gets the distance (in pixels) from the top edge of the specified CommandBarPopup control to the top edge of the screen. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets the type of CommandBarPopup control. Read-only.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Gets or sets the Visible property of the CommandBarPopup control. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Gets or sets the width (in pixels) of the specified CommandBarPopup control. Read/write.

properties.name: IsPriorityDropped
properties.description: Gets True if the CommandBarPopup control is currently dropped from the menu or toolbar based on usage statistics and layout space. (Note that this is not the same as the control's visibility, as set by the Visible property). Read-only.

properties.name: CommandBar
properties.description: Gets a CommandBar object that represents the menu displayed by the specified popup control. Read-only.

properties.name: Controls
properties.description: Gets a CommandBarControls object that represents all the controls on a popup control. Read-only.

properties.name: OLEMenuGroup
properties.description: Gets or sets an MsoOLEMenuGroup constant that represents the menu group that the specified CommandBarPopup control belongs to when the menu groups of the OLE server are merged with the menu groups of an OLE client (that is, when an object of the container application type is embedded in another application). Read/write.

methods.name: Copy
methods.signature: Copy([Bar As Variant], [Before As Variant]) As CommandBarControl
methods.description: Copies a CommandBarPopup control to an existing command bar.

parameters.name: Bar
parameters.description: A CommandBar object that represents the destination command bar. If this argument is omitted, the control is copied to the command bar where the control already exists.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: A number that indicates the position for the new control on the command bar. The new control will be inserted before the control at this position. If this argument is omitted, the control is copied to the end of the command bar.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the CommandBarPopup object from its collection.

parameters.name: Temporary
parameters.description: True to delete the control for the current session. The application will display the control again in the next session.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Runs the procedure or built-in command assigned to the specified CommandBarPopup control.

methods.name: Move
methods.signature: Move([Bar As Variant], [Before As Variant]) As CommandBarControl
methods.description: Moves the specified CommandBarPopup control to an existing command bar.

parameters.name: Bar
parameters.description: A Command object that represents the destination command bar for the control. If this argument is omitted, the control is moved to the end of the command bar where the control currently resides.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: A number that indicates the position for the control. The control is inserted before the control currently occupying this position. If this argument is omitted, the control is inserted on the same command bar.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets a built-in CommandBarPopup control to its original function and face.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: Moves the keyboard focus to the specified CommandBarPopup control. If the popup is disabled or isn't visible, this method will fail.
